components.css: .ds-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E9EBEF;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,26,46,.05),0 2px 6px -1px rgba(15,26,46,.04),0 8px 24px -6px rgba(15,26,46,.07);font:400 13.5px/20px Inter,sans-serif;color:#17191C;width:360px}.ds-card header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 24px 12px}.ds-card h3{margin:0;font:600 15px/20px Inter,sans-serif}.ds-card a{color:#2B4BD6;font-size:12.5px}.ds-card-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 24px 20px}.ds-card-row b{color:#137A60;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: The state of money on a loan.

narrative.overview: Acervus is a well-kept book of accounts that lives on one PC. Figures lead; the interface stays out of their way. Every screen answers "where is my money and who owes me" before it offers anything to do, and every number on it can be traced back to a recorded transaction. The tone is calm, exact and discreet. Nothing shouts unless money is late.
keyCharacteristics: Numbers first: tabular figures everywhere, amounts right-aligned in any list or column, never truncated.
One accent (Ledger Blue) for action and selection only.
Raised white cards on a cool grey ground, with three-layer shadows.
Spring motion on hover, press, selection and arrival; nothing loops.
The whole window is used. The layout reflows across four widths instead of centering a fixed column.

rules.name: The Money-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red describe the state of money. They are never decoration, category colors or brand accents.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Ledger Blue marks the thing you can act on or the thing that is selected. If two blue buttons compete on one screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures (tnum, plus cv11 for the single-storey a), so columns of money line up digit for digit.

rules.name: The Right Edge Rule
rules.body: Amounts in lists, tables and side-by-side columns are right-aligned. Labels stay left. A KPI's figure stays left-aligned under its own label, because it reads as one unit with it.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: Cards are sheets on a desk: raised, never floating, never nested. Floating is reserved for layers that cover content.

dos: Do take every color, size, radius, shadow and spring from ui::theme.
Do right-align amounts in any list or column, with tabular figures.
Do move secondary actions into a Dropdown before letting the header wrap.
Do branch layouts on Width, never on raw pixel checks.
Do use springs from theme::motion for any state change that moves or fades.
donts: Don't truncate money to fit a row; change the layout instead.
Don't nest cards or float a card; Floating belongs to overlays.
Don't use status colors for decoration.
Don't add looping or page-load animation; motion only answers input or state.
Don't put more than one primary button in a view.
